$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-dialog) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer. header is the header slot, header#1 the title-and-description frame inside it, action the Close button's frame.

root.$why: The border is outside the box in Figma, drawn as an outer 1 px shadow before the Surface/Dialog shadow. Figma's root is a vertical auto-layout with no padding or gap; code stacks the header, body and footer in a flex column.

action.$why: Figma wraps the Close button in a 28 px frame; code uses the Ghost sm icon-only Button itself, whose own padding draws the same 28 px box.
